# M0-S4: [project] keys: edition and name validation, name is
# informational, and strict_files gates loGo/s extensions.
env GOPROXY=off
env GOTOOLCHAIN=local

# Unsupported edition fails with the pinned error.
cd badedition
! logos build .
stderr 'logos\.toml:2:11: unsupported edition "2027" \(want "2026"\)'
cd ..

# Empty project name fails with the pinned error.
cd emptyname
! logos build .
stderr 'logos\.toml:2:8: project name must not be empty'
cd ..

# Two builds differing only in name produce identical binaries.
cd samename
logos build -o $WORK/one$GOEXE .
cp logos-two.toml logos.toml
logos build -o $WORK/two$GOEXE .
cmp $WORK/one$GOEXE $WORK/two$GOEXE
cd ..

# strict_files = [".lgo"] rejects the .⚡ file with the pinned error.
cd strict
! logos build .
stderr '\[correctness::extension_not_enabled\] x\.⚡: extension \.⚡ is not enabled by logos\.toml strict_files'

# With the key absent the same module builds and runs.
rm logos.toml
logos build .
logos run .
stdout '^zap$'
cd ..

-- badedition/go.mod --
module badedition

go 1.27

-- badedition/main.lgo --
package main

func main() {}

-- badedition/logos.toml --
[project]
edition = "2027"

-- emptyname/go.mod --
module emptyname

go 1.27

-- emptyname/main.lgo --
package main

func main() {}

-- emptyname/logos.toml --
[project]
name = ""

-- samename/go.mod --
module samename

go 1.27

-- samename/main.lgo --
package main

import "fmt"

func main() { fmt.Println("hello") }

-- samename/logos.toml --
[project]
name = "one"

-- samename/logos-two.toml --
[project]
name = "two"

-- strict/go.mod --
module strict

go 1.27

-- strict/main.lgo --
package main

import "fmt"

func main() { fmt.Println(Zap()) }

-- strict/x.⚡ --
package main

func Zap() string { return "zap" }

-- strict/logos.toml --
[project]
strict_files = [".lgo"]
